tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page / poster ground. Night (ليل الجريد) is the campaign default; Day (ملح الشط) is for light print runs and documents.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Mid-tone of the night radial gradient; cards on the ground.

tokens.name: sky-glow
tokens.usage: Centre of the radial sky glow behind the arch (radial-gradient sky-glow → surface-raised → surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the display title. 12.9:1 on surface-raised (night), 14.7:1 on surface (day).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary lines under info values (dates detail, age range). 9.5:1 night, 7.2:1 day.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Tagline (Aref Ruqaa) and icons. Amber on night (8.3:1); on the day ground switch to the deep date brown (5.4:1).

tokens.name: kicker
tokens.usage: Kufi kicker line above the org name (الكشافة التونسية · جهة المهدية).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: دقلة النور — Deglet Nour amber. Member price sticker fill, crescent moon, sparkle stars, frieze rule. Text on it is on-amber.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: جمر — campfire ember. The seal, the title's offset shadow, the phone icon disc. Cream text on ember only at 19px bold or larger (3.2:1); smaller text uses ember-deep.

tokens.name: ember-deep
tokens.usage: Ember for small text or thin strokes: cream on it reaches 4.8:1; on the day ground as text 4.8:1.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: طوب — Djerid fired brick. Arch frame and frieze (as the brick SVG motifs, never as a flat fill behind text).

tokens.name: brick-light
tokens.usage: Raised-brick face in the relief motifs; kicker text on night.

tokens.name: brick-mortar
tokens.usage: Mortar lines between bricks in the motifs.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: ملح الشط — salt cream. Call pill ground, arch inner rule, text on ember and night.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Fixed deep night for text on cream/amber regardless of theme (call pill number, price numbers).

tokens.name: palm-silhouette
tokens.usage: Moonlit palm silhouettes at 55% opacity at the poster edges. Decoration only: never behind body text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that frame the info row and separate its three cells.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on amber fills (9.5:1).

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on ember fills, 19px bold and up (3.2:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The event title on a 1080px-wide poster. Two to four words. Always with the ember offset shadow (0 6px 0 ember).

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Carousel slide titles, section titles in reels.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: One short poetic line under the title, accent-text colour. Five words at most; never for information.

styles.name: org
styles.usage: The unit name in the header.

styles.name: info-value
styles.usage: The three facts in the info row: when, where, who.

styles.name: info-label
styles.usage: Detail line under an info value, ink-muted.

styles.name: cta-number
styles.usage: Phone number in the call pill. Always in an LTR span (dir="ltr") so the digit groups keep their order.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Amount in a price sticker; the د at 20px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: خيمة تحت النخيل، نار، ونجوم الجريد.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Sticker labels. Smallest size on any poster (print: 12px minimum after scaling).

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Kicker above the org name; its square geometry echoes the brick walls.

styles.name: seal-text
styles.usage: Text set on the seal's ring (SVG textPath).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside an info cell (icon → value → label).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between price stickers; pill inner gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Info row vertical padding; gap between pill and stickers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pill end padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Minimum clear space around the seal and between poster bands.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Side margin of 1080px-wide feed and story posters.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Side margin for print (A4) and the story header; top safe zone of stories starts at 150px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags, carousel number chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards in documents and the web platform.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Call pill, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: The Djerid arch: top-left and top-right radius = half the arch width, bottom corners square.

tokens.name: shadow-arch
tokens.usage: Lifts the brick arch off the night sky.

tokens.name: shadow-title
tokens.usage: Ember offset under the Lalezar title (use as text-shadow, scaled with the type).
